segments.name: Lithography Systems
segments.description: Development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems.
segments.evidence: ASML has one reportable segment, since we are a holistic lithography solution provider, for the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems, consisting of lithography, metrology and inspection systems.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase lithography systems through sales orders and volume purchase agreements, with revenue recognized upon system delivery and installation or completion of services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers generally commit to purchase systems, service or field options through separate sales orders and service contracts.
